tasks.title: Add reproducible harness benchmark metrics
acceptanceCriteria: The public API and CLI aggregate historical runs.
The report preserves run, source, contract, and evidence provenance.
An explicit baseline can be compared without inventing missing data.

tasks.title: Exercise the portable CLI lifecycle
acceptanceCriteria: The CLI plans, starts, verifies, retries, and records human approval gates.

tasks.title: Reject tampered context snapshots
acceptanceCriteria: Context provenance is bound to its semantic snapshot hash.
The API and CLI reject modified context.

tasks.title: Validate an API through persistence
acceptanceCriteria: A real request reaches the database and the result is independently verified.

tasks.title: Validate a responsive UI journey
acceptanceCriteria: A real browser proves the journey, responsive layouts, accessibility, and visual evidence.
